scripts.dev: pnpm --dir apps/matchmaker exec wrangler dev -c wrangler.jsonc -c ../game-session/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project packages/fen/tsconfig.json && tsc --project apps/matchmaker/tsconfig.json && tsc --project apps/matchmaker/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --project apps/game-session/tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migration: pnpm --dir apps/matchmaker exec wrangler d1 migrations create DB
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --dir apps/matchmaker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm --dir apps/matchmaker exec wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=../../packages/database/seed.sql
